You don't announce this.
You don't search for it on a shared device. You don't ask anyone in your circle. You don't post about it, mention it or leave a trail.
But something in you knows it is time.
The burnout that has been building for longer than you have admitted.
The anxiety that sits behind the performance.
The mental and emotional weight that has nowhere to go in a life lived at the very highest levels.
The exhaustion that sleep no longer fixes and that no one around you can fully see.
The detox you know you need physically and also mentally.
Those health issues or injuries that you need to get on top of.
You need real support. Profound, expert, life changing, ultra private support.
And you need it in a way that no one will ever know about.
That place exists.
And this is what it looks like...
Why Is It So Hard for High Profile and High Net Worth Individuals to Get Mental Health and Burnout Support?

blocks.alt: 5 star high end exclusive private residence retreat packages

blocks.text: There is a particular kind of exhaustion that comes with being known or relied on at an excessive level.
Not just the exhaustion of the work itself, though that is enormous.
But the exhaustion of never being fully off.
Of knowing that how you appear, what you say and where you are is always, on some level, being watched.
Most of our clients are visionary. Some are handed the role and expected to fulfil it.
All have never fully realised what the extent of living it would mean until they are in it day by day.
For elite athletes, the public image of physical and mental perfection is the brand.
For musicians and performers, showing fragility in the wrong moment can define a career.
For actors and creatives, vulnerability is the instrument and having nowhere safe to express it privately is a particular kind of isolation.
For executives and founders at the highest level, the person at the top is never supposed to be the one who needs help. Markets move on perception. Boards lose confidence. Teams lose faith.

For high net worth families, the privacy concern is different but equally real. Protecting those you love, shielding family struggles from public or social scrutiny and finding genuinely private support for someone in the family who is struggling requires a level of discretion that conventional options simply cannot provide.
So they manage it.
They push through.
They find ways to keep going.
You involve more help and more people.
And slowly who you are gets left behind.
Even when everything inside them is asking for something different.
The biggest issue all of our clients face is - what happens if I stop?
The fall out is catastrophic.
That's where Alive comes in.
Why Most Private Mental Health and Wellness Retreats Don't Offer True Confidentiality

blocks.alt: confidential retreats for high networth individuals, high performers a

blocks.text: Privacy is a word used freely in the wellness and mental health industry.
Most high end retreats have it on their website.
Most luxury facilities mention it in their marketing. And almost all of them mean something entirely different by it than you do.

A beautiful resort can be secluded and exclusive. But it still has other guests no matter how high end that private residence is. Still has staff who recognise faces. Still has social media pages full of images of its location and clientele. Still requires a booking under a real name processed through systems that are not fully contained.

Even the most discreet wellness and mental health facilities and rehabs operate in shared environments. Shared dining rooms. Shared treatment spaces. Shared grounds where an unexpected encounter is always possible.
For most people this is completely fine.
For you it is not an option.

True confidentiality is not about a beautiful location or a discreet reception team. It is a complete architecture of privacy that surrounds every single element of your experience from the first point of contact to long after you leave.
That is an entirely different thing. And almost no one delivers it.
When you are ready to snap you think you have three options:
Bring your own team in (and you can't control that very well nor are they are all working with a system that is proven and they all still are reliant on being 'fed' from you)
Head away for a luxury spa break and hope that fulfils your needs
Go to a rehab and risk the stigma (even though you may not need rehab)
None of these are actually built for just you, fully understanding your circumstances and fully designed for 360 degree life, health, mind, career and self transformation in record time.
How Did Alive Become the Most Trusted Private Retreat for High Profile Clients?
Alive was not built for the mass market and then adapted for high profile clients.
It was built in that world from the very beginning.
When the founder first developed the Alive process she was working within the world of multi millionaire creatives in art, film and music.
People whose names were known.
Whose private struggles existed in complete contrast to their public personas.
Who were falling apart quietly behind some of the most extraordinary careers and lives the world had ever seen.

They needed profound support for burnout, mental health, health, detox, emotional collapse and the particular kind of suffering that comes from living at the very highest levels of human performance and visibility.

She watched them go over and over to rehabs that were 'well known' but left with no results. They didn't need rehab. They needed a full private team that fully understood them and could customise a program to their needs.
When they had nowhere safe to go....
... Alive was created to be that place.

Fifteen years later nothing about that founding purpose has changed. The depth of understanding for what these lives actually demand, what they cost and what genuine recovery looks like for someone carrying that weight, is built into everything we do.
Who Trusts Alive With Their Most Private Mental Health and Burnout Treatment?

blocks.alt: private exclusive confidential mental health retreats

blocks.text: Our clients include some of the most recognised and high profile individuals in the world alongside high net worth families and private individuals who require the same level of discretion.
Elite athletes carrying the weight of careers built on physical and mental perfection with no room in their public image for anything that looks like fragility.
Musicians and performers who give everything on stage and have nothing left when they walk off it.
Actors and creatives whose emotional lives are their instrument and who have no safe space to fall apart when that instrument finally breaks.

Executives and founders who have built extraordinary things and quietly burned out in the process. Senior leaders who carry the mental and emotional weight of thousands of people's livelihoods and have never once been able to admit how much that costs them.

High net worth families who need completely private, expert support for a family member who is struggling, whether that is a partner, a child, a parent or themselves, without that struggle becoming visible to anyone outside their most trusted circle.
You do not need to be famous to come to Alive. You need to require the highest level of privacy, the deepest level of care and a program that actually works.
We do not share names. We do not discuss our clients. We do not reference who has been with us in any form.
What we can tell you is that.... we have seen everything.
Every level of visibility, success, wealth and public profile. Every version of burnout, health crash, breakdown, edge point, melt down and mental health struggle.
Every kind of extraordinary human being who has reached the point where something has to change.
And every single one of them arrived as a person.
Not a profile. Not a name.
A person.
That is how we see them. That is how we see you.
We don't get star struck - we get to work.
And in that work we will not yes you to death like you are probably accustomed to.
We are real, we are up front, we will tell you the truth and we will bring you back home to who you really are beyond what you do on every possible level.
Our clients genuinely appreciate that we don't bend to to the profile or public identity or the power - they love that we only want to work with the real human behind the mask.
That is who we are interested in. That is the person we want to bring back to life.
How Does a Completely Confidential Private Mental Health and Burnout Retreat Actually Work?
This is not a standard privacy policy. It is a complete and deliberate architecture of confidentiality built around every single element of your experience.
It begins before you even make contact.
You can reach out under an alias. A trusted member of your team, your manager, your PA, your lawyer or your therapist can make the initial enquiry entirely on your behalf.
Our first conversation will be at your pace, on your terms and through whatever channel feels safest to you.

From that moment forward your identity is held within the strictest possible boundaries across every member of our team. Every therapist, health professional, coach and support staff member operates under comprehensive confidentiality agreements that go far beyond standard industry requirements.
What you are working through, why you are here and who you are remain entirely contained. Always.

Your program is built and delivered under whatever level of discretion you require. For many clients this means a first name only arrangement throughout their entire stay. For others it means complete anonymity from beginning to end.
From the outside you are on holiday. In a private luxury villa in Bali or Mexico. That is all anyone needs to know. That is all anyone will ever be able to find out.
What Does a Completely Private Burnout and Mental Health Retreat Look Like Day to Day?

blocks.text: Every therapy session, every medical appointment, every coaching conversation and every element of your daily experience happens within the complete privacy of your own space.
You are not a guest at a retreat. You are the only person in your world.

At our Elite level you stay within a private luxury residence at our exclusive retreat location in Mexico or Bali. A completely secluded, expansive private residence where your dedicated team operates entirely around you with absolute discretion. No shared resort facilities. No other guests. No visibility of any kind.
The program does not change between tiers.
The setting, the scale of privacy and the level of seclusion differ.
The depth, the expertise and the results are identical.
Why Does Complete Privacy Accelerate Mental Health and Burnout Recovery?
Here is what most clients do not fully anticipate until they experience it.
When you are genuinely, completely private for the first time, something shifts that has nothing to do with the program itself.
You stop performing.

The version of you that manages perception, that monitors every word and expression, that holds itself together because the alternative is not possible in your normal life, that version finally gets to rest.
And in that rest, the real work becomes possible in a way it cannot be when any part of you is still being watched.
The things you have never said out loud because there is no one safe enough to say them to. The fears that exist beneath the confidence everyone around you relies on.

The grief, the exhaustion, the burnout that has been carefully hidden behind a public face that gives nothing away. The weight of being the person everyone else needs you to be, all of the time, with no real space to fall apart.
This is the space where all of that can finally be put down.
Not performed. Not managed. Actually put down.
And what that creates in terms of genuine healing, clarity and transformation is unlike anything that can happen in any other environment.
This is what true privacy delivers. Not just discretion. Liberation.
What Does the Private One to One Burnout and Mental Health Program at Alive Actually Include?

blocks.alt: high 5 star luxury wellness and mental health retreats

blocks.text: Once that safety is established, the depth of what Alive delivers becomes possible in a way that changes everything for your self, relationships, career, health, creativity and well... everything.
Your dedicated expert team works across every dimension of your burnout or mental health experience simultaneously.
Everything is built around you. Every program customised to your needs.
A fully private, one on one experience that works across every part of your life at the same time.
On the physical level, we restore what burnout and stress have depleted.
Health, energy, sleep, nervous system regulation, detox, gut health and nutrition are all addressed with precision. This is where the body resets and the foundation for everything else begins.
On the mental and emotional level, we go straight to what’s underneath.
One on one therapy, coaching, and integrated mind tools work to shift patterns, reduce pressure, and create real clarity. Not coping. Not managing. Changing how you think, respond and operate.
On a practical level, we work through your life and business.
Decision making, boundaries, leadership, relationships, direction. The areas that carry the most pressure are brought into focus and restructured in a way that actually works for you.
Movement, environment and experience are part of the process.
Training, yoga, time in nature, ocean, space, stillness, and where appropriate, adventure and cultural experiences. Not as activities, but as part of how your system resets and reconnects.
You are held in a five star environment throughout.
Private space. Seamless service. No demands on your time.
Everything taken care of so you can fully step out of the pressure and into the process.
This is a complete 360 approach.
Health. Mind. Life. Relationships. Environment.
All working together.
Not just to help you feel better.
But to change how everything functions moving forward.
Why Do High Profile Clients Trust the Alive Team With Their Most Vulnerable Moments?
One of the most consistent things our clients describe is the experience of being with people who are genuinely not affected by who they are.
Not starstruck. Not intimidated. Not trying to leverage proximity to a high profile individual for their own benefit.
Just present. Skilled. Completely focused on the human being in front of them.
Our team has worked at the highest levels for many years. They have sat with some of the most recognised people in the world at their most vulnerable and most human moments.
They have seen extraordinary success and extraordinary pain existing side by side in the same person.
They understand the particular loneliness of a life lived at the very top.
The performance that never fully switches off. The gap between who you are publicly and who you are privately.
And they bring one thing to every moment. Genuine care for the human being in front of them.
Not for the profile. Not for the story. For the person.
We love helping humans. That is where our fulfilment lives. Not in who you are or what you have built. In who you become when you finally have the space and the support to heal properly.
How Do High Profile and Private Individuals Take the First Step Toward Confidential Support?
We understand that even reaching out can feel like the hardest part.
For someone whose privacy is paramount, making an enquiry about something this personal requires a level of courage and vulnerability that does not come easily.
We have designed the process of first contact to be as safe as possible.

You can reach out under any name. Your manager, PA, lawyer, therapist or any trusted representative can make first contact entirely on your behalf. You can ask questions without disclosing anything personal. You can take as long as you need before sharing anything at all.
Our first conversation is simply a conversation. Private, human and entirely at your pace. No forms. No systems. No data trails beyond what is absolutely necessary and completely secured.
Nothing happens until you are ready. And nothing is ever shared.
Frequently Asked Questions About Confidential Private Mental Health and Burnout Retreats

How do I make an initial enquiry without revealing who I am? You can contact us under any name you choose. Your manager, PA, lawyer, therapist or any trusted representative can reach out on your behalf. We will never ask for identifying information in initial conversations and our team is experienced in navigating first contact with complete sensitivity and discretion.

Who on the Alive team knows my identity? Only those who absolutely need to in order to deliver your program. Every member of our team operates under comprehensive confidentiality agreements. Your identity, your reason for being with us and every detail of your program are held within the strictest possible boundaries throughout and beyond your stay.

Can I be certain that no one will know where I am or why? Yes. From the outside you are on holiday in a private luxury villa in Bali or Mexico. That is all anyone can know because that is all there is to know. Nothing about your program, your team or your experience is visible, searchable or traceable.

Do I have to be famous or high profile to come to Alive? Not at all. You need to require genuine privacy, world class expertise and a program that actually works. Our clients include high net worth families, private individuals and those who simply require the highest level of discretion alongside those who are publicly known. What unites them is the need for something exceptional and completely confidential.

What if I need a trusted person to manage logistics around my visit? We work regularly with personal assistants, security teams, managers, lawyers and therapists. We are experienced in coordinating with your inner circle at whatever level of involvement you are comfortable with while maintaining complete confidentiality at every point.

What programs are available confidentially? Every Alive program is delivered with the same complete confidentiality. Whether you are with us for burnout recovery, mental health transformation, advanced holistic wellness or a complete 360 life reset, the architecture of privacy surrounding your experience is identical and absolute.
This Is Not Visible. And That Is the Point.
No announcements. No visible absence that requires explanation. No check ins. No traces.
Just a private villa in Bali or Mexico. A world class team. And the space to finally deal with what has needed dealing with for longer than you have been willing to admit.
You come as whoever the world needs you to be.
You leave as whoever you actually are.
And no one will ever know the difference except you.
When you are ready, we are here. And the first step is as private as everything that follows.
